name: Allura Red AC
aliases: E129, INS 129, allura red AC, allura red, FD&C Red No. 40, FD&C Red 40, Red 40
what_is: Allura Red AC (E129 / INS 129) is a synthetic red colour used to give foods and drinks a red or reddish appearance.
why_botia: Allura Red is a synthetic red colour. In the EU, foods containing it must carry a warning that it may affect activity and attention in children. That warning comes from the 2007 Southampton study, which tested mixtures of several colours together with sodium benzoate — not Allura Red on its own. JECFA set an ADI of 0–7 mg/kg body weight and concluded that estimated dietary exposure was below that level.
can_1: Detect E129, INS 129, Allura Red AC, Red 40 and its other declared names in the ingredient list.
can_2: Explain the EU activity-and-attention warning, where it came from and why the Southampton study cannot show that Allura Red alone caused the reported effect.
cannot_1: Determine how much Allura Red is present in a product from the ingredient list.
cannot_2: Predict whether a particular child will show an effect or treat a study of additive mixtures as proof of an effect from Allura Red alone.
